cands.name: Kyandra Darling
cands.bio: Democratic nominee, unopposed, for open HD 62 (incumbent Michele Rayner ran for state Senate). Fourth-generation St. Petersburg native and working mother; worked in the office of Rep. Charlie Crist, as legislative aide to St. Petersburg council members Steve Kornell and Lisa Wheeler-Bowman, and in the nonprofit sector.
cands.local_ties: Describes herself as a fourth-generation St. Petersburg native (campaign site). Current address not stated.
